title: X Mob Core
name: x_mob_core
short_description: High-performance, zero-dependency S.O.L.I.D. mob and spawner framework for Luanti.
long_description: A modular, zero-dependency mob engine and spawner framework for Luanti based on S.O.L.I.D. software architecture principles. Provides 3D A* hierarchical pathfinding, motor and steering controllers, glTF multi-track animation dispatching, combat and tool wear mechanics, multi-agent pack coordination, and dynamic natural mapgen and trickle spawning.
